function.arguments: {"observation": "The `sklearn` library is not available in the environment, so logistic regression cannot be used for multivariate adjustment. This prevents the use of a standard method to control for multiple confounders (age, sex, site, assay_batch).", "implication": "The multivariate adjustment method proposed earlier cannot be implemented. Therefore, we must fall back to a simpler approach: report the adjusted effect for severity (which is the most important confounder) and explicitly state that other confounders remain unaccounted for. Any causal interpretation is invalid. The best we can do is report the severity-adjusted difference in proportions, with a clear caveat that it is not a fully adjusted treatment effect due to unmeasured confounding."}
function.name: note_finding
